description: Block or warn high-risk requests that could weaken supply-chain defenses.

rules.description: Warn when the user asks to install a package with npm install instead of the secure wrapper.

action.message: Use `npm run defence:add -- pkg@version` instead of `npm install`. Direct installs bypass age, signature, vulnerability, and license checks.

rules.description: Block requests to remove ignore-scripts from .npmrc.

action.message: Removing `ignore-scripts=true` weakens Layer 6 protection. If you need lifecycle scripts for a specific package, follow the safe rebuild procedure documented in the security layers.

rules.description: Warn when a user asks to bypass a security gate.

action.message: Bypassing security gates requires documented maintainer approval. Explain why the gate cannot be satisfied.
